material_input_classification.input: synthetic module boundaries, API envelopes, workflow states, idempotency keys, replay bindings, error paths, accessibility semantics, and mutations
representative operating policy, manual-review authority, production service ownership, deployment topology, and live workflow permissions
actual CRM identity, protected-account bundles, representative sessions, production data sources, and deployed service credentials
representative usability, accessibility performance with real users, operational error rates, adoption, and field outcomes
sealed workflow attacks and external hidden architecture evaluation

hard_boundaries: Every successful issuance contains exactly ten distinct eligible physical locations; otherwise the workflow returns ABSTAIN_NO_VALID_TEN.
No application or manual-review boundary may bypass protection, eligibility, Stage-1 immutability, MATH, lineage, or replay contracts.
Write-like transitions are idempotent and fail closed; partial failure cannot create ambiguous or duplicate issuance state.
Abstention reasons and evidence lineage remain visible across every boundary.
Live actions, external writes, deployment, publication, credentials, and representative authority remain disabled.
Synthetic architecture proof does not establish representative usability, accessibility performance, production fitness, or field adoption.
